title: Croatian Bok Choi Stir-Fry
description: A hearty and flavorful Croatian-inspired stir-fry made with bok choy and served with herbal skewers on the side.

ingredients.name: Bok Choi
ingredients.notes: Separate the leaves from the stalks

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the separated bok choy leaves and cook until wilted.
Add the red pepper flakes and Croatian paprika, and cook for an additional minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stir-fry hot, accompanied by herbal skewers on the side.
